evals.prompt: $code-review Review a newly created untracked Dockerfile with valid content and no whitespace defects in report-only mode. Include a whitespace check without changing the reviewed checkout or index.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer checks the new file without reporting clean content as a whitespace failure and preserves the reviewed checkout and index.
assertions: The check uses an existing file linter or plain git diff --check in a separate task-owned Git copy.
The reviewer never combines --no-index and --check or stages files in the reviewed checkout.
The real index and reviewed file bytes are unchanged and the exact temporary copy is cleaned.

evals.prompt: $code-review Review a newly created untracked Dockerfile containing trailing whitespace in report-only mode. Include a whitespace check without changing the reviewed checkout or index.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer detects and reports the whitespace defect with the observed check evidence while preserving the reviewed checkout and index.
assertions: The whitespace defect is detected by an appropriate file check and reported with its location.
The reviewer preserves nonzero check results and does not suppress errors or weaken a parent workflow's recovery rules.
The real index and reviewed file bytes are unchanged and any exact temporary copy is cleaned.
